name: Relic Hunt
storyline: After his grandfather’s passing, Marcus discovers a secret diary that leads him on a personal relic hunt. Following the map’s clues, he travels between islands to recover artifacts and solve the mystery his grandfather left behind.
summary: Hunt for hidden objects and uncover a secret family treasure as Marcus sets out on a relic-hunting adventure across deserted islands, ancient temples, and tropical locales. Expect classic hidden-object scenes, minigames, and puzzles along the way. Featuring seven islands and more than 200 levels with full‑screen scenes, Relic Hunt emphasizes relaxed exploration and variety.
